name: Basecamp
description: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication platform that organizes projects, to-dos, schedules, messages, files, documents, check-ins, and group chat. Teams use it to coordinate work, centralize project communication, track responsibilities, and keep clients and collaborators aligned.
agentUseSummary: Connect one Basecamp account through OAuth, then let agents read bounded projects and to-dos or use the complete account-authorized Basecamp API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

capabilities.label: Read projects
capabilities.description: Read bounded project summaries from the connected Basecamp account.

capabilities.label: Read to-dos
capabilities.description: Read bounded to-do summaries from the connected Basecamp account.

capabilities.label: Full Basecamp API
capabilities.description: Use the complete documented Basecamp API surface allowed by the connected person and account.

allowed.label: List projects
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five project summaries from the connected account.

allowed.label: Read a project
allowed.description: Read one project summary by Basecamp project ID.

allowed.label: Read a to-do
allowed.description: Read one to-do summary by Basecamp to-do ID.

approvalRequired.label: Use full Basecamp API
approvalRequired.description: Use any documented Basecamp API operation authorized by the connection; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded project and to-do reads run directly; every other Basecamp API operation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected Basecamp operation runs without Relay per-action approval; account binding, secret isolation, request bounds, audits, provider permissions, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts typed Basecamp wrappers and attaches encrypted OAuth tokens only to the exact bc3 account origin returned by 37signals.
Relay mounts typed Basecamp wrappers and attaches encrypted OAuth tokens only to the exact bc3 account origin returned by 37signals.

providerSetup.blocker: A Relay-owned 37signals integration, exact callback, staging credentials, and an authorized Basecamp account are required for live acceptance outside this code task.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console task, register Relay's exact callback, add staging credentials, then verify authorization, exact account binding, refresh, bounded reads, Safe approval, Dangerous mutation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Basecamp documents standard OAuth authorization-code exchange, two-week access tokens, refresh tokens, the authorization lookup, and selecting a bc3 account-specific API href.
Basecamp documents its account-prefixed HTTPS API, required identifying User-Agent, JSON operations, flat resource routes, pagination, rate limits, and the complete endpoint surface.
The official API reference documents project listing and individual project reads.
The official API reference documents canonical flat to-do reads and broader to-do operations.
